info.title: kenaz-ml
info.description: kenaz-ml — the ML sidecar for Sigil (local mode)

post.description: Register or renew a client lease (FR-011). Local mode only.

Graceful shutdown, authorized by ``Authorization: Bearer <token>`` (FR-015).

The token is read on every request from the client-owned
``<install_root>/lease/shutdown.token``. Fails closed: a missing lease
directory or token file, an empty or unreadable file, no token or a
wrong one all refuse and the engine keeps running. On success the
response is sent first; then in-flight training drains (bounded), the
poller stops, and the process exits through the graceful path.

get.description:
Sidecar self-description for the kenaz ML Config view (spec 060).

Returns the sidecar version plus per-model identity, training
freshness, and recent prediction activity. Values not tracked today
are honest nulls/zeros — see ModelIntrospection.

post.description:
Dispatch one recommendation to the kind's single registered backend.

Every refusal (kind_not_served, laya_backend_not_installed,
contract_mismatch, unknown_kind, ...) is HTTP 422 with a
``{"error": <code>, "refusal": {kind_id, reason, detail}}`` body. Never substitutes a
different backend; never clamps confidence.

get.description: Every registered kind's ordered feature contract and serving availability.

post.description: Cursor-acked, revision-upserted label ingest (FR-007..009). Loopback only; no outbound call.

413.description: More rows than the batch limit; nothing acked

409.description: Contract / names / retained-header mismatch; nothing written

503.description: Label log I/O failure; nothing acked

post.description:
Stateless feature-event push (FR-023): validated against a closed class
registry, held in a bounded in-process store. No table, no file, no outbound call.
Local mode only: in cloud mode the route answers ``lane_unavailable``.

422.description: Batch too large, or the lane is unavailable

supported_versions.title: Supported Versions
supported_versions.description: Versions accepted by /v1/recommend. Only the current one today (no N-1 defined).

ContractEntry.title: ContractEntry
ContractEntry.description:
One kind in ``GET /v1/contracts``, keyed by kind id in :class:`ContractsResponse`.

``features``/``backend``/``available`` are the fields the harness's
``KindContract`` reads; ``available`` is true only when a backend actually
serves the kind (the harness gates routing on it). ``version`` is the
kind's 16-hex contract version (D-A4).

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: Every registered kind, keyed by kind id.

event_class.title: Event Class
event_class.description: Closed registry: "commit" (specified); egress_deny, run_outcome, budget_pressure, lifecycle (schema-deferred, refused).

ts_ms.title: Ts Ms
ts_ms.description: Event time, positive integer milliseconds (for commit: the commit time).

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Class-specific fields; must be empty for commit.

FeatureEvent.title: FeatureEvent
FeatureEvent.description:
One pushed feature event. Validated per event by ``features_push`` so a bad
event never fails its batch; the loose types here are deliberate.

product.title: Product
product.description: Always "kenaz-ml" (the product name; the frozen artifact keeps its own frozen name).

contract_versions.title: Contract Versions
contract_versions.description: Per recommend kind, the feature_contract_version values /v1/recommend accepts.

exe_path.title: Exe Path
exe_path.description: This process's own resolved executable path; not self-verified.

engine_sha256.title: Engine Sha256
engine_sha256.description: sha256 of the engine's own executable file (sys.executable resolved through symlinks; the launcher executable in the frozen onedir), computed once at startup. An adoption cross-check for the client, never a trust root; null only if the file could not be read.

model_details.title: Model Details
model_details.description: Per-model status with registry refusal text.

device.title: Device
device.description: Compute device; "cpu" for the scikit-learn engine.

lifecycle_protocol.title: Lifecycle Protocol
lifecycle_protocol.description: Lifecycle protocol version: 1 = speaks /v1/clients/lease; 0 = none (cloud mode, legacy).

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description:
``/health`` — honest enough for a client to verify (FR-016, Amendment A1).

The pre-existing fields are unchanged (C-008; ``models`` stays name ->
status string). Every field added by two-client-engine-01MSK2EN is
**required**: the model cannot be built from ``{}`` or a partial payload, so
a bare or legacy response is structurally distinguishable from this one.
``exe_path`` is reported truthfully and never verified here — verification
is the client's job (FR-017, C-001).

LabelBatchResponse.title: LabelBatchResponse
LabelBatchResponse.description:
``applied`` = new keys, ``replaced`` = higher-revision upserts, ``stale`` = not newer.

``acked`` is the ``(ts, revision)`` of the last row of the batch, in the
order sent — always a row of this batch (never beyond the pushed window).
Per-row refusals are permanent (no re-send can fix them), so the ack
advances past them; each is listed in ``refusals`` (Amendment A4). A
batch-level failure (409 / 413 / 503) acks nothing. ``null`` only for an
empty batch.

LabelCursor.title: LabelCursor
LabelCursor.description: The ack cursor: a position over ``(ts, revision)``.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: The row's original created_at (ms); part of the key, never changes.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Table-global monotonic change counter; higher replaces.

features.title: Features
features.description: Feature values keyed by name (a JSON object, or its JSON text).

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that answered (the harness's model_id).

client.title: Client
client.description: Optional; defaults to the batch's client.

feature_contract_version.title: Feature Contract Version
feature_contract_version.description: Optional; when present it must equal the kind's published contract version.

snapshot_ms.title: Snapshot Ms
snapshot_ms.description: Optional feature snapshot time (ms); ts is used when absent. Carried, never recomputed.

LabelRow.title: LabelRow
LabelRow.description:
One ``advice_labels`` row, in the harness's wire shape (``mlsidecar.LabelWireRow``).

Frozen contract (Amendment A3.3): idempotency key
``(client, kind, features_hash, ts)``; ``ts`` is the row's original
creation time and never changes across revisions; ``revision`` is the
harness's table-global monotonic change counter, and a higher one replaces
the stored row (equal or lower is stale). Propensity fields are kept
verbatim in the kind's label log; only ``accepted`` / ``auto_acted`` (y=1)
and ``dismissed`` (y=0) rows with ``features_complete=true`` reach the
retained training set. There is deliberately no ``session_id``.

min_contracts.title: Min Contracts
min_contracts.description: Per kind, the feature_contract_version this client requires. Only reported back (incompatible_kinds); never stops the engine serving other clients.

incompatible_kinds.title: Incompatible Kinds
incompatible_kinds.description: kind -> why this client's min_contracts is unmet.

managed.title: Managed
managed.description: True when the install root's lease/ directory exists.

refusal.title: Refusal
refusal.description: Registry refusal reason text (integrity/contract/runtime), or null.

ModelHealth.title: ModelHealth
ModelHealth.description: Per-model health detail (WP05). ``refusal`` carries the registry's refusal text.

ModelIntrospection.title: ModelIntrospection
ModelIntrospection.description:
Per-model metadata for the /introspect endpoint.

Honesty contract (kenaz spec 060): fields the sidecar does not track
today are returned as null/zero — never invented.

error.title: Error
error.description: Stable typed code, e.g. kind_not_served, contract_mismatch.

RecommendRefusal.title: RecommendRefusal
RecommendRefusal.description:
Every typed refusal: HTTP :data:`REFUSAL_STATUS_CODE`, this body.

``error`` is the stable machine code at the top level — the envelope the
harness's ``mlsidecar`` client parses (``{"error": "<code>"}``; a code of
``kind_not_served`` satisfies its ``ErrKindNotServed``). ``refusal`` repeats
it with the kind and a human-readable detail.

features.title: Features
features.description: Feature values keyed by name; must match the kind's contract.

feature_contract_version.title: Feature Contract Version
feature_contract_version.description: The contract version the client computed features under.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Opaque client session id; not interpreted by the engine.

kind_id.title: Kind Id
kind_id.description: Optional; when present it must equal the path's kind.

features_hash.title: Features Hash
features_hash.description: Optional: the label row's features_hash for this decision (exact shadow join).

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: Optional: the label row's ts (decision time, epoch ms) for this decision.

RecommendResponse.title: RecommendResponse
RecommendResponse.description:
A served recommendation (FR-004). Exactly one of ``decision``/``score``.

Field semantics for values the specs leave open:

* ``rung`` — the serving manifest's ``metrics["rung"]`` when present,
  otherwise the backend name (a test fixture reports ``"heuristic"``).
* ``checkpoint_provenance`` — the registry slot that served the artifact
  (``local`` / ``base``); ``org`` is reserved for an org-distributed pack.
  A test fixture has no checkpoint and reports ``local`` (in-process).
* ``model_id_sha8`` — first eight hex characters of the serving artifact's
  ``artifact_sha256``; ``null`` when there is no artifact (a fixture).
* ``generation`` — the serving manifest's ``Manifest.version``; ``"0"`` when
  there is no artifact.
* ``unbenchmarked`` — ``true`` unless the manifest records
  ``metrics["benchmarked"] is True``; always ``true`` for a fixture.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Stable machine reason, e.g. kind_not_served, contract_mismatch.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Human-readable diagnostic, e.g. 'kind unavailable: contract v3 != v2'.
